blocking: Motion initialization failure can leave the control reporting playback while animations remain disabled.
Desktop parallax transforms the entire page-height tree; rendering cost needs device-level verification before launch sign-off.

fixes.what: Use initMotion()'s result to update playback state. If initialization fails, preserve the paused state and stop video playback; make the next activation retry initialization.
fixes.why: Currently playAll() ignores failure, starts the video and displays Pause even after initMotion() has disabled animation.

fixes.what: Move desktop parallax onto bounded artwork sections instead of transforming the full-height .tree; profile scrolling with the inquiry textarea expanded.
fixes.why: A page-height composited artwork layer can become expensive as content grows; clean console and overflow checks do not establish smooth rendering.

fixes.what: Keep the hero logo visible from first paint and animate only its small vertical displacement, removing the opacity-zero start and delay.
fixes.why: The current enhancement hides an already available primary brand asset for a 1.1-second reveal, delaying readable content and potentially LCP.

fixes.what: Listen for changes to the connection's Save-Data preference and recheck it before each video start; pause and avoid loading when it becomes enabled.
fixes.why: Save-Data is captured only once, so later preference changes cannot stop the background video's data use.

fixes.what: Measure layout shift on cold-font loads at 390px and short viewport heights; tune the initial content-height reservations to match the measured layouts.
fixes.why: Writing the measured height after font loading changes hero height and downstream section positions; font metric matching alone does not verify zero layout shift.
